data.narrative:
Loft Orbital is a Series C space and aerospace company that has raised $326M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a peer set of three same-stage, same-sector private companies (Sierra Space at $8.0B, Varda Space Industries at $1.5B, and Skyryse at $1.1B), alongside reference to five public Space & Aerospace comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) trading at a median 26.4x price-to-sales.

Two triangulation methods apply here. Stage-progression analysis, using the $326M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier, implies $554M. Peer-median analysis across the three same-stage, same-sector comps yields $1.5B, reflecting the wide dispersion in the peer set ($1.1B to $8.0B). Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied without disclosed revenue figures, which remain unavailable for private companies.

The two applicable methods triangulate to a range of $471M (low) to $1.7B (high), with a median of $1.0B. The wide peer range and material gap between stage-progression and peer-median results reflect uncertainty around Loft Orbital's relative maturity, unit economics, and addressable market penetration versus its comparables. Resolution of these operational metrics would narrow the valuation band materially.
